recommendation: Keep the commit. It fixes the remaining core conformance-surface contradiction without reopening the separate core publicationDate element question. If a work group still wants MetadataResource.publicationDate as a core element, handle it as a new committee decision with explicit propagation rules; otherwise use the Extension Pack artifact-publicationDate extension.
issue_request: FHIR-37858 was Published/Persuasive for R5. It requested changing CanonicalResource.date from publication-date wording to the date the {{title}} was last significantly changed, adding comment guidance that date may be present on draft content, and adding publication-date support for MetadataResource including the artifact-publicationDate extension suggested in the Jira comment.
initial_application: Git 378fe392dd102168828a322355a66656eff4d1bb changed CanonicalResource.date and the publishable pattern element definition/comment away from publication-date wording. Git 49b86f8a6978650d8f8a6d36d27dee0433e455bc retained that wording with localization guidance and recorded FHIR-37858. The checked-in date search parameter template and resource search parameter bundles still described .date as a publication date.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes confirm the persuasive vote. Zulip discussion raised first-vs-last publication and implementation propagation questions and said the publicationDate core-interface question needed committee review. A later FHIR-extensions decision, FHIR-51512, added artifact-publicationDate for any Metadata Resource in the Extension Pack. fhir.ini keeps CanonicalResource and MetadataResource active and maps MetadataResource.date to CanonicalResource.date.
reconciliation: Updated the publishable search-parameter template and all checked-in date search parameter bundle descriptions that still called .date a publication date. The descriptions now identify date as the last significant change date. No core MetadataResource.publicationDate element was added because that part of the original request remained unresolved in community discussion and the current publication-date mechanism is external in the Extension Pack.

source/canonicalresource/bundle-CanonicalResource-search-params.xml: changed CanonicalResource-date description to match CanonicalResource.date semantics.
